// diagnostic

E2818

HTTP route method `{method}` belongs to a struct that is never mounted.

What

HTTP route method `{method}` belongs to a struct that is never mounted.

Why

Route markers record facts; only an explicit mux.mount(value) exposes that struct's routes.

Fix

Pass a value of `{type}` to mux.mount, or remove the route marker.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E2818: tests/ui_lint/http_route_unmounted.warn.

Warning [jet.UnmountedHttpRoutes]: HTTP route method `joke` belongs to a struct that is never mounted.
  --> http_route_unmounted.jet:4:5
    |
  4 |     #Server.Get("/jokes/:id")
    |     ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: Route markers record facts; only an explicit mux.mount(value) exposes that struct's routes.
 Fix: Pass a value of `Dormant` to mux.mount, or remove the route marker.
